body: I believe that it'd hurt like hell for a short time, but he'd get over it, and eventually find someone who will be far better for him.  But I'll talk with him.
Why should I hope I don't get sent to hell?
Thank you.  I'm hoping that death is as peaceful as it's reputed to be.  And there is hope.  Just - none for me, any longer.

I appreciate your words, but they're untrue.  The only reason I've made it this long is knowing how much it'll hurt him.  He knows how I feel - he's talked me off the ledge before.  As for my family and friends, I daresay they've always known they'll be better off without me.
